# SSDV DSLWP decoder

This directory vendors the DSLWP-compatible fork at:

- https://github.com/daniestevez/ssdv
- Based on Philip Heron's original https://github.com/fsphil/ssdv

The code is used for ASRTU/DSLWP 218-byte SSDV packet reconstruction. It is
licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later; the complete upstream license is retained in
`COPYING`.
